title: SimpleCov coverage.json
description: Schema for the coverage.json file emitted by SimpleCov's JSONFormatter. Versioned independently of the gem. Non-breaking additions bump the minor segment of schema_version, breaking changes bump the major segment. The versioned file at schemas/coverage-vX.Y.schema.json is the canonical artifact for that version, schemas/coverage.schema.json is a convenience alias for the latest.

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema this document conforms to. Pinned to the versioned canonical URL so documents stay validatable against the exact contract they were emitted under, even after the schema evolves.

schema_version.description: Schema major.minor. Additive changes bump minor; breaking changes bump major. Update this `const` whenever the schema version is bumped so documents claiming a different version don't quietly validate against this contract.

simplecov_version.description: The version of the SimpleCov gem that produced this file.

command_names.description: The distinct run names behind the report, one entry per merged run (a single-run report carries one). `command_name` joins these with ", "; consumers that need the components (e.g. to summarize "A and N other runs") should read this array rather than split the joined string, since a run name can itself contain a comma. Optional: absent from documents written before it existed.

root.description: Absolute path to SimpleCov.root at the time of write.

commit.description: Full git commit SHA of `root`'s HEAD when the report was generated, or null when the project isn't a git checkout (or git isn't available). Lets tools recover the exact source a report reflects, which matters most when `source_in_json` is false and the per-file `source` arrays are omitted.

primary_coverage.description: The coverage criterion `SimpleCov.primary_coverage` names as primary. The HTML report sorts file lists by this criterion's coverage by default.

coverage.description: Map of project-relative file paths to per-file coverage data.

contexts.description: Ids of every recorded context, in recording order. A context is any labeled region of execution; under SimpleCov's `track_tests` each context is one test, identified by the location of its definition relative to `root` (e.g. "spec/user_spec.rb:42"). Present exactly when the formatted result carried a complete context map, meaning every merged result recorded one (an empty array means contexts were recorded and no test ran). Absent when recording was off, or when a merge mixed recorded and unrecorded results and therefore dropped the map. Per-file `contexts` bitmaps in `coverage` entries index into this array.

groups.description: Map of group names to per-group totals plus the list of files in the group.

history.description: The run history (coverage/.history.json entries, oldest first, this run appended last): per-criterion totals plus per-group and per-file percentages, with the branch and commit when the project is a git checkout. Powers the HTML report's sparklines. Optional: present only when past runs are recorded.

errors.description: Threshold violations from minimum_coverage, minimum_coverage_by_file, minimum_coverage_by_group, maximum_coverage, maximum_coverage_drop, maximum_missed, maximum_missed_per_file, and the per-file baseline. Empty object when no thresholds were violated.

minimum_coverage.description: Keyed by criterion: lines, branches, methods.

minimum_coverage_by_file.description: Keyed by project-relative filename, then by criterion (lines, branches, methods).

baseline.description: Baseline-floor violations from the checked-in per-file baseline (see `simplecov ratchet`). Keyed by project-relative filename, then by criterion (lines, branches, methods).

minimum_coverage_by_group.description: Keyed by group name, then by criterion (lines, branches, methods).

maximum_coverage.description: Keyed by criterion: lines, branches, methods. `expected` is the configured maximum, `actual` is the measured value that exceeded it.

maximum_coverage_drop.description: Keyed by criterion: lines, branches, methods.

maximum_missed.description: Keyed by criterion: lines, branches, methods. `maximum` is the configured cap on the number of misses, `actual` the measured count, both in the criterion's own units.

maximum_missed_per_file.description: Keyed by project-relative filename, then by criterion (lines, branches, methods). `maximum` is the configured per-file cap on the number of misses, `actual` the file's measured count.

lines.description: Per-source-line coverage. Element index N corresponds to source line N+1. Integer hit-count, null for non-relevant (blank/comment) lines, or the string "ignored" for lines inside a simplecov:disable / :nocov: region. Present if and only if `meta.line_coverage` is true. When present, the five line stat fields (`lines_covered_percent`, `covered_lines`, `missed_lines`, `omitted_lines`, `total_lines`) are guaranteed to be present too.

source.description: Source lines of the file, in order (one entry per physical line). When the per-file `lines` array is present it has the same length, but `source` is emitted independently of line coverage. Present only when SimpleCov.source_in_json is true (the default); omitted when downstream tools opt out via `source_in_json false` to keep coverage.json smaller.

covered_lines.description: Count of executable lines that were hit at least once.

missed_lines.description: Count of executable lines that were never hit.

omitted_lines.description: Count of non-executable lines (blank lines, comments). Mirrors `total.lines.omitted` at the per-file level. Excludes lines inside simplecov:disable / :nocov: regions, which surface as `"ignored"` in the `lines` array.

total_lines.description: Count of executable lines: `covered_lines + missed_lines`. Does not include non-executable (omitted) lines or lines inside simplecov:disable / :nocov: regions, so this can be smaller than `lines.length`.

branches.description: Per-branch coverage. Present if and only if `meta.branch_coverage` is true. When present, the four branch stat fields (`branches_covered_percent`, `covered_branches`, `missed_branches`, `total_branches`) are guaranteed to be present too.

methods.description: Per-method coverage. Present if and only if `meta.method_coverage` is true. When present, the four method stat fields (`methods_covered_percent`, `covered_methods`, `missed_methods`, `total_methods`) are guaranteed to be present too.

contexts.description: Per-context covered-line bitmaps for this file. Keys are decimal string indices into the document-level `contexts` array; values are lowercase hex bitmaps where bit N set means source line N+1 was executed by that context. Emitted only when the document-level `contexts` array is present and at least one recorded context executed a line of this file, so an absent key under a present `contexts` array means no recorded context touched the file.

type.description: Branch kind from Ruby's Coverage library (e.g. "then", "else", "when").

report_line.description: Line of the conditional that owns this branch (the `if`, `case`, or `&&` line), not the start of the branch body. Useful for rendering annotations at the decision point.

files.description: Project-relative paths of the files that fell into this group.

omitted.description: Lines that cannot be covered (blank, comment, etc.). Only present on line stats.

total.description: Executable lines: `covered + missed`. Does not include `omitted`.

strength.description: Average executions per coverable line: the sum of hit counts divided by `covered + missed`.
Average executions per coverable branch or method: the sum of hit counts divided by `covered + missed`.

line_coverage.description: Coverage value for a source line in the per-file `lines` array. Integer hit count, `null` for a non-executable line (blank or comment), or the literal string `"ignored"` for a line inside a simplecov:disable / :nocov: region.

branch_method_coverage.description: Coverage value for a branch or method `coverage` field. Integer hit count, or the literal string `"ignored"` for code inside a simplecov:disable / :nocov: region. Unlike line coverage, `null` never occurs: every branch and method maps to an executable construct.

expected.description: The floor percent the baseline records for this file and criterion.

actual.description: The measured percent, rounded down to two decimals.

allowed_missed.description: The missed count the floor allows. Absent for a percent-only floor, where the percent alone decides.

branch.description: The git branch, null when detached or outside a checkout.

commit.description: The git commit SHA, null outside a checkout.

totals.description: Per-criterion percents for the run, keyed line / branch / method (measured criteria only).

groups.description: Per-group per-criterion percents, keyed by group name.

files.description: Primary-criterion percent per project-relative file path.
